n: Sun Protection Day Cream SPF50+ PA+++
ex: A day cream and a broad-spectrum SPF50+ in one pump.
d: Moisturiser and sunscreen in a single step, which is the only version of sun care most people actually keep up with in Kampala heat.
Vitamin E, hyaluronic acid and collagen sit underneath the filters, so skin is fed as well as shielded.
bn: Hydrates so you can skip a separate day cream

ex: A bouncy collagen jelly that firms without any weight.
d: The jelly texture melts on contact and leaves skin plumped rather than coated, which is why it works in humidity where a richer cream would not.
A generous 110ml tub, so it is as usable on the neck and chest as on the face.
bn: Plumps and firms with collagen and peptides
Large tub for face, neck and chest

n: Kojic Acid Turmeric Vita Capsule Cream
ex: Kojic acid and turmeric capsules aimed straight at dark marks.
d: Vitamin capsules burst as you massage, releasing kojic acid and turmeric onto skin that is holding onto old spots and post-acne marks.
A cream rather than a serum, so it does the brightening and the moisturising in one step.
bn: Targets dark spots and post-acne marks
Capsules keep the actives fresh until use

ex: PDRN and hyaluronic acid for skin that needs repair, not just water.
d: PDRN is the ingredient Korean clinics use after procedures, and at this strength it suits skin that is dry, thin or recovering from over-exfoliation.
Hyaluronic acid holds the water in place; panthenol takes the sting out.

ex: Bamboo water and panthenol for skin that reacts to everything.
d: Purito build for sensitive skin, and this is the plainest of their creams: bamboo sap water instead of plain water, panthenol to settle redness, nothing to argue with.
Light enough to layer, rich enough to end a routine on.

n: Lush Blush NAD+ Peptide Boosting Cream
ex: NAD+ and peptides for skin that looks tired rather than dry.
d: NAD+ is the cell-energy ingredient the longevity crowd moved into skincare, paired here with peptides that work on firmness.
The finish is the point of the name: a flushed, lit-from-within look rather than a shine.

n: AHA BHA PHA 14 Days Super Miracle Spot All Kill Cream
ex: A dab-on cream for the spot you want gone by the weekend.
d: Three acids loosen the plug while 75% Truecica keeps the surrounding skin from turning red and angry.
A precision tube, so it goes on the spot rather than over the whole face.
bn: Helps stop a mark forming after
caution: For use on individual spots, not as an all-over cream. Wear sunscreen daily while using acids.

ex: The heartleaf line's richest cream, for skin that is both reactive and dry.
d: 70% heartleaf does the calming; the ceramides do the rebuilding, which is the combination skin needs after a bad reaction or a harsh few weeks.
Thicker than the daily lotion, so most people use it at night or only in the dry season.
bn: Rich enough for very dry patches

ex: A ceramide cream with 10% triple hyaluronic acid behind it.
d: Ceramides patch the barrier and the three weights of hyaluronic acid pull water into different depths of skin, so the hydration does not sit only on top.
Unscented and simple, which is what makes it easy to keep using.
bn: Hydration at three depths of skin

ex: Vitamin C held in capsules so it is still active when you use it.
d: Pure vitamin C goes off fast in a jar, so it is sealed into capsules that break under your fingers.
The result is a brightening cream that still has something to give at the bottom of the tub.
bn: Fresh vitamin C at every use

n: Retinol Vitamin C Vitamin E Cream
ex: Retinol, vitamin C and vitamin E in one night cream.
d: Retinol for texture and lines, vitamin C for tone, vitamin E to keep the other two stable and the skin comfortable.
A sensible way into retinol for anyone who does not want a third bottle on the shelf.
caution: Start two nights a week and build up. Wear sunscreen daily while using retinol.

ex: Straightforward hyaluronic hydration in a capsule cream.
d: No actives to manage and no fragrance to react to: this is the cream for the weeks when skin only needs water and quiet.
The capsules keep the texture light until you press them out.

n: Madagascar Centella Tender Cica Rescue Cream
ex: The rescue cream for skin that has had a bad week.
d: Centella grown in Madagascar is what the whole SKIN1004 range is built on, and this is the heaviest concentration of it they make.
Reach for it after sun, after a reaction, or any time skin feels raw.
bn: Comes with a spatula to keep it clean

n: Seoul 1988 Fiber Capsule Cream - Niacinamide 5% + Yuja
ex: 5% niacinamide and Korean citron for dull, uneven skin.
d: Yuja is the citrus Koreans brew in winter tea, and it brings vitamin C alongside a proper 5% dose of niacinamide.
The fiber capsules give it a springy texture that sinks in rather than sitting.

ex: The cream half of the dark spot pair, for marks that keep coming back.
d: Built for post-acne marks and sun spots, with a texture light enough that oily skin will still use it.
Pairs with the serum from the same line if you want the full course.

n: Time Revolution Night Repair Ampoule Cream 5X
ex: The night cream version of Missha's most copied ampoule.
d: Fermented bifida is the ingredient that made the Time Revolution ampoule famous, concentrated here into a cream you sleep in.
Skin reads smoother and more even by morning; the change in firmness takes a few weeks.
bn: Works overnight on texture and tone
Fermented ingredients the skin takes up easily

ex: PDRN and collagen capsules for firmness and bounce.
d: The firming end of Medicube's PDRN range: collagen for structure, PDRN for repair, held in capsules until you press them out.
Best used at night, when skin is doing the repair work anyway.

n: No.1 Panthenolic B5 Active Soothing Cream
ex: Panthenol at the front of the list, for skin that is sore.
d: numbuzin number their range by job, and No.1 is the soothing one: a high dose of B5 with centella behind it.
The texture is a light balm that melts, so it suits sore skin that does not want to be rubbed.

n: Yuja Niacin Brightening Moisture Gel Cream
ex: A gel cream that brightens without the weight of a cream.
d: Yuja and niacinamide on dull skin, in a gel base that disappears in Kampala humidity instead of sliding.
The brightening choice for oily and combination skin that cannot wear a proper cream.

ex: Oat water in a gel, for sensitive skin that gets oily.
d: Oat has calmed irritated skin since long before skincare was an industry, and here it is the base of the formula rather than a footnote.
A gel rather than a cream, so sensitive skin that shines by midday finally has something it can wear.
bn: Oat-water base instead of plain water

ex: Rice and orchid in the cream that made the brand.
d: Beauty of Joseon build on hanbang, the old Korean court recipes, and the Dynasty Cream is the one people keep rebuying.
Rich without being greasy, which is a harder balance than it sounds.
bn: Deep moisture that lasts the night
Softens the look of fine lines

ex: A tinted centella cream for blemish-prone skin.
d: Tea tree and centella treat what is underneath while the tint evens out what shows, so breakout-prone skin is not choosing between care and cover.
Light coverage only - this is skincare with a tint, not foundation.
bn: Evens out tone with light coverage
Comfortable all day on oily skin

ex: Niacinamide and tranexamic acid, aimed at pores and marks together.
d: Tranexamic acid is the pigment ingredient dermatologists reach for when niacinamide alone is not enough, and celimax pair the two at sensible strengths.
Ceramide NP keeps the barrier intact so the actives do not cost you comfort.
bn: Targets dark spots and stubborn pigmentation

ex: Half the tube is centella, and there is no fragrance anywhere in it.
d: 49% centella with nothing added for scent, which is the version sensitive skin should be buying.
Purito's most recommended product for a reason: it is boring in exactly the right way.

ex: The pore line's moisturiser, with gentle acids kept in.
d: Most pore products stop at the cleanse; this one carries low-level AHA and BHA through to the moisturising step so pores stay clear overnight.
The gel texture suits the skin that buys pore products in the first place.
bn: Panthenol stops the acids drying you out
caution: Contains AHA and BHA. Wear sunscreen daily.

n: Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Cream
ex: The brightening cream in the centella range, with vitamin capsules.
d: Centella keeps the skin calm while niacinamide and vitamin capsules work on tone, which is the half most brightening creams leave out.
Light enough for daily use under sunscreen.
bn: Calms as it works on tone
